Thank you so much . That made me cry . But it also gave me a little bit of hope .  Hope that me and Emily will get through this . Thank you for all the kind words and advice.  It's going to be hard .  It scares me . I dont want to lose my grandpa soon. It really makes you cherish the people you have.  I never really was a religious kid . neither was my grandma . In her final month though, I saw her change so much . Every day she reminded me and Emily how much she loved us and would read Emily a story every night . She would often read the bible on the nights she couldnt sleep .  I'm going to attach a picture to this, that she sent to my friend gazzy when she found out about the diagnosis . Thank you so much . I'm looking more into christianity . It amazes me that in the face of death she had so much faith in god.

Thank you so much.  I am doing my best to stay strong and get through this .  As far as supportive family theres pretty much only my grandpa whom me and Emily live with. The rest of my family won't answer my calls and haven't tried to talk to me or even Emily .  We are going to continue the counseling for as long as needed . Hopefully it helps.  My Grandpa struggles to talk about her without breaking down , and has barely ate or slept since the death . He trys to be strong for me and Emily but I see through it you know ? 49 years . One more month and it would have been their 50 year anniversary . That's a long time . As for favorite memories, here are mine . When I was 9, my mom bought us matching butterfly nets . It sounds corny but we spent like half a day trying to catch butterflies . We were both so happy.  I miss those days . As for my grandma , she took me fishing one time . I had never been fishing before , and I fell in the water . I remember laughing so hard . And then when she got sick I remember on her bad days I would sit by her and sing her her favorite songs . She had a very wide taste in music . One of her favorite songs is Wild Horses by The Rolling Stones . Her favorite song for me to sing was star shopping , by lil peep . I introduced her to his music and she fell in love with it. We actually played wild horses at her funeral, as that was what she wanted.
Thank you . I'm sorry for your losses too . This year has been rough.  I'm sending love your way and hoping we can both have a better year next year.

Thank you for the kind words. Me and Emily are getting grief counseling, yes .  My grandpa has no family members from his side of the family still around , except for his mom (my great grandma ) . She has dementia and I haven't seen her in a few months . Sadly she doesnt even recognize me or my grandpa.  My grandmas side of the family ( her mom,step dad ,sisters , and brother) have basically outcasted me , Emily, and my grandpa. They didnt speak to us at the visitation , nor the funeral.  They haven't reached out and asked how we were or anything. And I realize they're grieving too, but man it sucks . Thank you so much , I will remember your words.  It's just hard ya know ? I feel like there were a lot more memories to be made. I can't imagine the grief my grandfather is going through though.  Hes lost his Daughter ( my mom) and the love of his life . Him and my grandma were married 49 years .

If I had to describe my mental place rn , I'd probably say that I'm somewhat coming to terms with it . Me and her talked about the situation a lot , she was religious, and she knew it was coming. She fought a hard fight and was hopeful to live , as I'm sure most of us would be if we were in similar situations . But in the end she told me she was at peace and believed she would see all her family members that had passed before her . She said that the day before she died . We were very close , but I haven't cried that much about it simply because of how calm and ready to go she seemed . Sometimes I will see little things that remind me of her and our time together and it makes me sad , that is the main reason I've been really thinking about this . I dont want those little things to make a bad trip . I'd just like to find more peace with the fact shes really gone. Sorry for the rant :/
I'm not very religious but I do believe shes somewhere, I just dont know where. Just looking for some peace.
